greater_tables — demo 2

TeX cells, long-text wrapping (both Fabricator generators), wide-range floats in engineering format, and the csv-grid width solver in both modes. Regenerated by tests/make_goldens.py.

TeX / math cells

Fabricator 'x' columns arrive $-wrapped; the engine's math auto-detect flags them and the walker emits \(...\) for page-level MathJax (loaded from CDN below; KaTeX injection is the SPA alternative).

Long text, low variance ('s' generator)

Uniform 14-word sentences. gt-wrap prose columns wrap at --gt-prose-max (30em default); numeric columns stay gt-nowrap.

Long text, high variance ('w' generator)

Negative-binomial word counts — a few very long cells among short ones. Natural browser layout: the column takes its longest-line width up to the prose cap, everything wraps.

Wide-range floats → SI suffixes (default eng display)

Column-level inference: normal-scale floats get grouped decimals; log-wide and extreme-range columns trip an engineering rule (mean outside 10^[-3,6] — the GT rule — or nonzero span ratio beyond 10^6 — the csv-grid rule) and render with SI suffixes (µ m k M G T…). The empty suffix slot is a no-break space so decimals align. Exponent style is the 'eng' sugar opt-in, fixed-width e+00/e-00.

SI suffixes, tiny magnitudes

Sub-atomic scale values; suffixes run down the 2022-extended SI ladder (a z y r q) so a column never mixes suffix and exponent style.

Width solver: natural layout (reference)

The same high-variance table again, unconstrained.

Width solver: fit 'equal-risk' at 560px

The equal-VaR allocator copied verbatim from csv-grid: bisects for the shared quantile q so every column truncates with probability 1−q. Forces single-line ellipsis cells (the solver’s objective assumes it).

Width solver: fit 'coverage' at 560px

The coverage allocator: maximizes the count of fully-shown cells via a concave-envelope water-fill — completes cheap columns, concentrates truncation on the expensive outliers.
